HEADLINE: Luxury spending now driven by experiences and 'inheritourism'

blog.headline: Why Luxury’s Future Lies in Experiences, Not Just Objects
blog.angle: Luxury spending shifts from heritage goods to experience-driven offers → Brands face the tension of honoring legacy while innovating → LVMH’s move into hospitality shows how to capture growth → Reinventing the luxury offer is essential to stay relevant.

linkedin.headline: You can’t pass down a vacation, but you can inherit the taste for one.
linkedin.angle: Luxury buyers are moving from collecting objects to collecting moments, forcing brands to rethink growth strategies beyond traditional goods.

facebook.headline: Luxury is no longer just about owning rare items.
facebook.angle: Luxury spending is shifting toward experiences and inheritourism, as LVMH expands into hospitality—how is your brand adapting to this shift?

instagram.headline: When Legacy Meets Experience Economy
instagram.angle: Luxury brands that blend heritage with immersive experiences tap into evolving consumer desires and unlock new growth.
